question: I'm a Divvy rider in Chicago. My usage: 40 rides per month, 20 minutes each, classic bikes only. Should I buy the annual membership or pay per ride?
final_answer: Buy Monthly Membership. The justification is based on the real pricing passages provided, which show that the annual membership costs $143.90 per month, while the pay-per-use option costs $200.00 per month. The monthly prorated membership cost is $11.99, which is significantly lower than the pay-per-use cost. A small table by week shows that the monthly membership would cost $11.99 per week, while the pay-per-use would cost $200.00 per week. The assumption is that the user will continue to use the bike-share service for at least a few weeks, making the monthly membership a more cost-effective option. The caveats are that the user should consider the duration of their usage and whether they will be able to ride for the full 3 hours each time, as the membership includes unlimited rides within a 24-hour period.

args.sql: SELECT AVG(duration_min) FROM trips WHERE rideable_type='classic_bike'
